title: Doc comment batch: error consistency, backend_state, KITH_BIND_ADDR, auth.rs
description:
What: Add or fix doc/inline comments in four locations to improve clarity and security documentation.

Why: These are all comment-only changes. Grouped into one bead because they are tiny and independent.

Algorithm — four edits:

1. KITH-626.8 — Fix error message inconsistency in kith-tslocal/src/lib.rs:
   In whois(), find the JSON parse error around line 284:
     .map_err(|e| AuthError::WhoIsFailed(format!("parse: {e}")))?;
   Change to match status() style:
     .map_err(|e| AuthError::WhoIsFailed(format!("parse whois JSON: {e}")))?;
   (status() uses "parse status JSON: {e}" — now both are consistent.)

2. KITH-626.12 — Add backend_state justification comment in kith-tslocal/src/lib.rs:
   At the backend_state match (around lines 250-253), add a comment above explaining
   why exactly those four states are acceptable when user_id is empty. Example:
   // NeedsLogin/NeedsNodeKey/NoState/Stopped are known pre-authentication states
   // where Tailscale has not yet assigned a user identity. An empty UserID in
   // these states is expected; any other state indicates a misconfiguration.

3. KITH-v7t.6 — Add security note for KITH_BIND_ADDR fallback in kithd/src/config.rs:
   At resolve_fallback_bind_addr(), around line 155 where KITH_BIND_ADDR is read,
   add a comment: // KITH_BIND_ADDR is a deprecated alias retained for compatibility.
   // Do not use in new deployments; it bypasses the KITHD_* namespace convention.

4. KITH-c5d — Add auth.rs fail-closed clarification:
   In kithd/src/auth.rs classify() (around line 52), add or verify a comment on the Err arm:
   // Fail-closed: store errors surface as 500, not 401, so a DB failure
   // cannot be mistaken for an authorization decision.

Defensive rules:
- Comment-only changes. Do not touch any logic.
- cargo fmt must produce no changes after edits.
- cargo clippy must pass.

Closes: KITH-626.8, KITH-626.12, KITH-v7t.6, KITH-c5d
notes: Also closes KITH-v7t.12: add comment explaining make_svc.call(peer_addr) bridge pattern in kithd TLS accept loop.
